tables.title: Standby mode
tables.text: Table 60, "Standby mode", in section 13.7.7 (Standby mode) on page 382. Columns: Standby mode, Description. 3 data row(s).

rows:
The CPU subsystem is in Stop mode, and there is no active EXTI wake-up source.
PDDS bit for select Standby
All WKUPF bits in PWR_WKUPSR cleared

WKUP pins rising or falling edge, RTC alarm (alarm A and alarm B), RTC wake-up, tamper 
event, timestamp event, external reset in NRST pin, IWDG reset
System reset phase (see Section14.5.2: System and application resets (sys_rst, nreset_rstn))
